scope: Exact Pfaffian certificate for BILR residual Waring rank >= 11 on gl_3 (dim 9).
theorem: Strassen/Hessian bound: for k cubes on V (dim n) with nondegenerate K=(1/6)Hess_R(p), the K-skew commutator [H_X,H_Y] has even rank at most 2(k-n). Thus Waring rank <=10 on gl_3 forces rank<=2 and Phi=0 for all X,Y. BILR has Phi!=0, proving Waring rank>=11. The converse Phi=0=>rank<=2 can fail for indefinite K; exact rank<=2 is characterized by the 4x4 Pfaffians of Omega=KC. Also tr(C^3)=0 is automatic and carries no information.
scaling_note: C = [6S_{X1}, 6S_{X2}] = 36[S_{X1},S_{X2}]. Phi(C) = 36^4 Phi([S,S]), so Phi(C) != 0 iff true Phi != 0.
